name: fraction_non_residential
notes: Share of the air filter market that is not residential. Grand View Research HVAC filters: residential 52.5% in 2025, so non-residential 47.5%. Other market reports suggest higher numbers. Global Growth Insights has residential at 28%, implying 72% non-residential. However, it also seems to suggest HEPA (and maybe other high MERV) filters are concentrated in healthcare, pharma, etc. so 72% may be overweighting availability for repurposing. Coherent research has non-residential at ~59%
